name: Navigation and Window Creation Policy
description: Restrict renderer navigation to only sanctioned URLs via will-navigate and did-navigate event handlers. Block window.open and new-window creation unless explicitly allowed by policy. All navigation denials produce security event receipts.
purpose: Prevent renderer-driven navigation attacks and unwanted window creation by enforcing a strict allowlist of navigation targets and window creation policies.
acceptanceCriteria: will-navigation handler enforces a URL allowlist on all BrowserWindows
did-navigate and did-navigate-in-page handlers validate final URL compliance
window.open and new-window events are blocked unless on an explicit allowlist
Navigation denials produce security event receipts
Policy is configurable per-BrowserWindow if needed
